description: Platform registry for the Agentica OS adapter. Adding a platform is a config entry here, not a code change. Path specs support ~ (home), {home}, and {governance} (the Agentica OS Governance dir) tokens.
telemetry_contract: telemetry_required is fail-closed: omitted means true. Set it false only when the platform is supported/installed but its production execution surface is explicitly disabled; telemetry_disabled_reason must name the operational gate. Re-enable the requirement in the same change that activates that surface.
execution_slot_contract: Slot E (C1). Each value names the FLAG OR MECHANISM that provides the capability, or null when the platform's headless surface does not have it. It is deliberately NOT the argv: the exact argument vector is owned by the adapter that spawns the process, so this registry and that spawn cannot drift (Anti-Pattern #2). Values verified against the installed CLIs' own --help on 2026-07-28.

gemini.telemetry_disabled_reason: Both live Order Samurai launchd surfaces explicitly set RIVAL_HARNESS=claude while Gemini authentication is unavailable; no production Gemini telemetry producer is active. Flip this to true in the same deployment change that removes that hold and wires the emitter.

governance-local.telemetry_disabled_reason: Registered 2026-08-19; agentica_core/llm/gateway.py:call_routed_llm now emits real records on every call, but zero calls have landed since registration so the stream does not exist yet. Flip to true once governance_llm.jsonl shows live records (data_telemetry_fresh would ERROR on a required-but-missing stream otherwise) -- same pattern as the gemini entry above.
